scripts.config:external: node scripts/with-site-env.mjs external -- node scripts/site-config.mjs external
scripts.config:internal: node scripts/with-site-env.mjs internal -- node scripts/site-config.mjs internal
scripts.dev:external: SITE_CONFIG=external WRANGLER_CONFIG_PATH=.wrangler.external.jsonc node scripts/with-site-env.mjs external -- node scripts/dev-server.mjs
scripts.dev:internal: SITE_CONFIG=internal WRANGLER_CONFIG_PATH=.wrangler.internal.jsonc node scripts/with-site-env.mjs internal -- node scripts/dev-server.mjs
scripts.build:external: pnpm config:external && pnpm clean:next && SITE_CONFIG=external node scripts/with-site-env.mjs external -- opennextjs-cloudflare build --config .wrangler.external.jsonc
scripts.build:internal: pnpm config:internal && pnpm clean:next && SITE_CONFIG=internal node scripts/with-site-env.mjs internal -- opennextjs-cloudflare build --config .wrangler.internal.jsonc
scripts.deploy:external: pnpm build:external && node scripts/with-site-env.mjs external -- node scripts/deploy-site.mjs external
scripts.deploy:internal: pnpm build:internal && node scripts/with-site-env.mjs internal -- node scripts/deploy-site.mjs internal
scripts.db:schema:external: pnpm config:external && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state/external --config .wrangler.external.jsonc --file=./schema.sql
scripts.db:schema:internal: pnpm config:internal && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state/internal --config .wrangler.internal.jsonc --file=./schema.sql
scripts.db:reset:external: pnpm config:external && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state/external --config .wrangler.external.jsonc --command="DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sessions; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS passkeys; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS passkey_authentication_challenges; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS emdash_authorization_codes; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users" && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state/external --config .wrangler.external.jsonc --file=./schema.sql
scripts.db:reset:internal: pnpm config:internal && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state/internal --config .wrangler.internal.jsonc --command="DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sessions; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS passkeys; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS passkey_authentication_challenges; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS emdash_authorization_codes; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users" && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state/internal --config .wrangler.internal.jsonc --file=./schema.sql
scripts.db:list:external: pnpm config:external && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state/external --config .wrangler.external.jsonc --command="SELECT * FROM users"
scripts.db:list:internal: pnpm config:internal && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state/internal --config .wrangler.internal.jsonc --command="SELECT * FROM users"
